_about: Labelled text-to-image queries for the image embedder alone (run_visual_eval.py ranks the 'clip' vector space, without captions, OCR or keywords). 'expect' lists file-name fragments; several fragments mean any of those pictures counts. Written by looking at the pictures, not from their captions.
